messages:
alex: SLO alert firing for hosted/infer p99 in euw1 — multiple customer tickets (CUST-3421). Anyone oncall?
maya: seeing the alert too. p99 jumped from ~220ms to ~1.3s in last 10m. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/euw1-infer (just for context)
devon: I briefly saw a lot of upstream 502/504s from batcher-v2 earlier. Could be prefetch backlog or handshake
ops-bot: Alert: SLO_BURN: hosted-infer/euw1/p99 > 200% (window=15m). Incident ID: inc-202703-87
jia: quick check — probe coverage shows a gap at 02:18-02:25 UTC, traces for real traffic are low-sampled.
maya: can someone run this logs query in logdog?

```
logs.query: service:hosted-infer env:euw1 | json | count by(response_code, upstream_service) | sort -count
```

devon: ran it — spikes in 504 from upstream=batcher-v2 and a small bump in 502 from proxy-layer. Response header shows `x-prefetch-ttl: 0` on many failures
alex: support repro attached: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <cust-token>" \n  -d '{"input":"short"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/infer -> intermittent 504s
maya: can we check KV cache metrics? if cache TTL dropped we'll regen a lot of prefixes which can add latency
jia: traces: the sampled traces we have end at the gateway; no handoffs to batcher spans for ~60% of failures — possible trace-gap or sampling bug
ops-bot: Deployment event: batcher-v2 autoscale attempted +2 pods at 02:22 UTC; rollout id: ro-9834
devon: sounds like a transient prefetch backlog combined with trace sampling drop. Immediate mitigation: toggle fallback routing to dedicated-reserve for affected customers?
alex: support prefers avoid customer-side retry logic. I'll enable canary fallback for CUST-3421 to quantized-small variant for 30m
maya: action items: 1) raise prefetch TTL in euw1 to 5m (temp) 2) increase batcher-v2 min-replicas 3) fix trace sampling config
devon: I'll open infra PR for min-replicas and start a manual scale now
jia: I'll check tracing config and bump probe sampling for gateway->batcher spans
alex: FYI I've updated the support ticket and told customer we have a mitigation in place. Notifying CSM.
maya: note for postmortem: need a dashboard comparing probe SLO vs user p99 (probe might be blind to real tail)
ops-bot: Note added to incident inc-202703-87: mitigation applied (canary fallback enabled), status: investigating
devon: manual scale +2 done at 02:27 UTC. monitoring for p99
maya: p99 decreased to ~280ms in last 3m, alert cooling. will leave mitigations for 30m then rollback if stable
alex: thanks all. please paste any follow-ups here and let's create a short runbook for this pattern
jia: adding a tracing playbook entry now -> link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/tracing-probe-gap
maya: closing loop: file a postmortem if incident persists or recurs within 7 days :thumbsup:
alex: ack, will draft postmortem if we see recurrence. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
